description: This file defines the IGrainBase interface and related extension methods used for grain lifecycle management in Orleans, including activation/deactivation handling, timer creation, and deactivation reasons.

classes.name: GrainBaseExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for creating and managing grain timers, deactivating, and migrating grains.

classes.name: DeactivationReasonCode
classes.description: Enumerates various reasons for grain deactivation, such as application requests, idle state, or failures.

classes.name: DeactivationReasonCodeExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for DeactivationReasonCode, such as checking if a reason is transient.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle grain activation logic, overridable by grain implementations.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle grain deactivation logic, overridable by grain implementations.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to deactivate a grain after the current method completes.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to initiate migration of the grain to another location.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Various overloads to create grain timers with different callback signatures and scheduling options.
